phase: Phase D3: the rest of the updates and the moderate/low list (by 2026-11-25)
summary: All static Lucide imports resolve, dotenv callers avoid changed loading behavior, and both sharp-isolating print proofs match. GenAI 3 changes the default API version; preview-model compatibility remains unverified.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Major] dashboard: GenAI 3 changes the Developer API default from v1beta to v1. The lesson-generation and augmentation defaults use gemini-3-flash-preview without an apiVersion. The SDK changelog warns that some preview models only exist on v1beta. These calls may fail and return HTTP 500 responses. Rationale: the r5 evidence checks types, not the API endpoint used at runtime. Pin v1beta or verify that this model works on v1 before accepting the AI flow.

F2 [Nit] dashboard: All 30 imported Lucide icon exports exist in 1.77.0, but no visual browser review checked their rendered shapes. Rationale: a package major can change SVG appearance without renaming icons. Request the dedicated UX browser review.
